title: Paint Saathi: House Painting
shortDescription: House painters in Agra, Mathura & Vrindavan. Itemised quote, zero advance.
fullDescription:
Paint Saathi is a managed house painting service. Tell us what needs painting, from one wall or a door to the whole house, and we take care of the rest: the site inspection, an itemised quote, genuine branded paint, a supervised crew and a clean handover.

Now painting in Agra, Mathura and Vrindavan.

WHAT YOU CAN COUNT ON
• Zero advance payment: You pay nothing up front. No payment is due before the work starts.
• Full estimate before work starts: An itemised quote after the site visit: area, preparation, paint, coats and timeline. Nothing starts until you approve it.
• Timed work: The quotation states how long the job takes, and the crew is sized to finish within it.
• Fully documented: A written quotation, daily photo updates, written approval for any change and an invoice at the end.
• Zero compromise on quality: Genuine branded paint, every preparation step the quote lists, and a supervisor checking each stage before handover.
• What's best for you, not for us: We recommend the paint, finish and repairs that suit your walls and budget, never the option that simply pays us more.

IN THE APP
• Book a site visit in about a minute: your name, mobile number and address. We call you back to fix a time.
• Find a wall colour by shade code, name or hex among 8,500+ shades from Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac and Nippon Paint, each shown on a room.
• Browse ready colour combinations for bedrooms, living rooms, pooja corners, kids' rooms and house fronts.
• Sign in with your mobile number to follow your project from booking to handover and download your quotations as PDFs.

SERVICES
Interior painting, exterior painting, doors, windows and small jobs, and rental property painting.

Our inspector brings the real shade cards to your home, so you choose colours in your own light. Paint Saathi isn't affiliated with these paint brands.
